public data boundary

Two inputs. One public projection.

GitHub owns public organization membership, repository facts, push dates, and activity. Mer3ly owns the editorial roles, summaries, statuses, and meaningful relationships layered over that roster. Both the semantic index and the Mere canvas consume the reconciled result. Refreshed 2026-09-24 11:46 UTC. If a future refresh fails, the last validated snapshot remains in place.
